title: Love of Christ
definition: The love of Christ is His faithful, sacrificial, holy, and saving love toward His people.
summary: Christ loves sinners with a love displayed supremely at the cross.
christFocus: Jesus loved His people and gave Himself for them, revealing the love of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The love of Christ is not vague sentiment. It is covenantal, sacrificial, holy, and active. He loves by giving Himself for sinners.

His love is displayed in His compassion, patience, correction, sacrifice, intercession, and keeping power. Nothing can separate believers from the love of Christ.

This love surpasses knowledge, yet it is truly known in the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people measure Christ's love by circumstances or feelings. The love of Christ matters because His cross defines His love with certainty.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Root your identity in the love of Christ. When accused by shame or shaken by suffering, return to the Savior who loved you and gave Himself for you.
